verdict.rationale: BigQuery ships an official CLI (`bq`) that can create datasets, load data and query tables without the console. It also has programmatic interfaces (an SDK, ODBC/JDBC drivers, the Storage Write API) and schedulable load jobs, and community reports describe scripts running queries unattended for hours. missing for 10: explicit documentation of CI-pipeline usage (service-account/non-interactive auth, CI examples), and depth of bq CLI scripting docs beyond the quickstart.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
